Error preference: NoData, both detailCode DT0xA0041001 -> BothSupportError, ADU resultInfo, DDR resultInfo, unsupported fallback. If any record invalid absolute timestamp flag or unparseable date return true (needs current-time acquisition); else false.

Phase6 controller read failure uses reason.result.detailCode (literal source shape): BothSupportError -> unsupported, NoData -> unavailable-data DL009, other common error; all OK menu. Metadata success true -> getDdrDataWithTimeStamp(), false -> getViewData(); then build multi-select S32200-13. Initial progress timers cleared on success/error.

Option2 cache only if not canceled. Canceled sentinel becomes {canceled:true}; other failures reject {result:reason.resultInfo.code,errorCode:reason.resultInfo.detailCode}; finally cancelFlag=false.

Time controller opens cancelable DL004, Promise.race(getTimeStamp(),buttonPressed->model.cancelGetTimeStamp()). Cancel creates worker cancelFlag=true, clears cached absolute maps, immediately returns converted viewPane with ctrlPane ONLY cycleList. Model creates a cancelKey but does not include it in getTimeStamp payload; cancelGetTimeStamp passes key but worker does not invoke native cancellation. Both race branches ultimately set model.ddrData; finally close dialog. Native in-flight request may finish later; no promise cancellation is inferred.

Selection screen transforms each raw row preserving API keyCycle/elapsedTimeList/upper+lower triggers/ddrType; checkbox disabled for keyCycle or elapsedTime hyphen. Header checkbox sets all boxes (including disabled via prop), row clicks skip disabled. Next enabled if any checkbox checked. Three filters keyCycle/trigger/date combine by hiding rows; option lists wrapped when incompatible. FilterCancel resets all0, shows rows. Checked records retained by id when back/recover; Next collects checked even hidden rows, isAllEnabled iff no unchecked box remains.

Selection Next getPcsReadTime builds ECU list airbag full supported funcs, ADU only func50 (undefined list if none), aduOperationFFDReadFlag0. selectList undefined for isAllEnabled else flat-map each checked record for max length(elapsed/upper/lower lists): {keyCycle:getApiKeyCycle,elapsedTime,triggerIdUpper,triggerIdLower}. getMaxLen returns0 if any undefined causes Math.max NaN. Read-time Next opens cancelable DL001. executeDdr creates cancelKey, current ecuId, selectViewData. Worker clears cancelFlag; phase6 getAduDdr, otherwise getAdsDdr476 when connected; then airbag getDdr. ACK-enabled calls true: if cancelId present register key->id, await response.response; resultInfo.cancel -> canceled sentinel. ADS/DDR success marks normalRes; ADU sets dtcCodeList for following DDR. Each operation catches into per-result object.

Selective getAduDdr/getDdr use {ecuId,outputLog:0,getCaseInfo:0,selectList}; filter checked records by ddrType aduDdr or ddr; empty matching data skips call. selectList undefined all enabled, else flatten parallel arrays as above. execute error priority: any per-result canceled sentinel -> canceled. Non-phase6 if normalRes but empty datasets or transformed rows -> NoData. Any native resultInfo.result0 -> success. Both support predicate (ADS detail DT0x90040501 OR ADU detail DT0xA0041001) AND DDR DT0xA0041001 -> isFuncSupportedfalse. Else prefer ADS,ADU,DDR resultInfo, then unsupported fallback.

After success optional legacy image storage discovery only if dataset condition passes, image setting true and not phase6. Sequential getCurrentTime airbag; support0 or failure -> fallback ADU ecu in phase6 else476. Failure fallback propagates. Return{isFuncSupported:true}; cancel flag returns{canceled:true}. Catch maps canceled->resolved canceled, NoData->reject{result:hyphen,errorCode:NoData}, supportError->resolved unsupported, other->reject{result:code??hyphen,errorCode:detail??hyphen}. Finally reset flag and clearCancelIds(cancelKey).

DL001 Cancel calls workerApi.cancelCommand(cancelKey) then sends ddr.cancelDdr which only sets flagtrue; opens loader until execute completes. Canceled legacy -> notice OK menu. Canceled phase6 -> Yes menu, No remain at read-time/selection state; rejects inner chain intentionally with no reason. Unsupported -> notice OK menu. Success phase6 getViewData; legacy getDdrDataWithTimeStamp; then buffer.save raw Ddr cache plus activity link, then list view. Fail NoData -> DL009 OK menu; other errorCode -> common dialog OK menu; all paths close DL001 and loader.

Image discovery loops exact ecuImage list 376,386 phase4;430,470,476,492,498,5005 phase5;6037,6537 phase6. Require status CONNECTED and any supported function34/40/41/42/43/44 legacy or51 phase6. getImageFfdStorageList({ecuId},true), ACK cancel registration, collect image spec + memory areas + airbagEcuId. API/storage failures swallowed; canceled may be swallowed inside storage catch. getTriggerArray joins Ddr.imageMap by phase: phase4 direct list;phase5[ecuId][spec][airbag][area];phase6[ecuId][specInfoType][spec][area], absent->[]. Full decoded table retained as exact constants data.

createViewData resets maps, builds absolute map by padded keyCycle, creates airbag rows plus ADU if isPhase6 else ADS, sort ascending keyCycle then elapsedTime strings; cycle/trigger/date lists lexical sort. Each DDR/ADS/ADU row validates any-zero upper/lower trigger invalid arrays, any invalidFlag0+wcFlag0x55 for trigger/pre/post write arrays, invalidTriggerList[0]0 and nonempty first valid trigger name. Stored filename vehicle info obtained using storedId0, regional/OEM field fallback preserved.

Phase6 uses elapsed arrays, legacy timing+sampling formulas. Preserve regional time conversion and temporary dateFormat1 restoration, missing timeAndDateSec writes timeAndDate underscore as source. All field order and unnamed columns exact in full CSV helper graphs.

Initial poll schedules commandThread every1000ms; workerApi sets main CHECK_CONNECTION_NAME_EXIST callback only after start result. ordered_transitions: Store this.functionName=param.parameter.functionName; branch on gts.util.isPhaseType5(ecuInfo.phaseType).
P5: await PID support, then RID support, then calculate return value.

When manual support is true, select manualModeType=2 if the first RID set is all supported, otherwise 1 if the second is all supported. This priority is based on RID support alone after the combined manual-support expression.

P4/non-P5: await type-decision support, then PID support. manualModeType=displayItemTypeMap[cacheData.utilityId]. Type 0 disables manual; all other values, including undefined, enable manual. Auto defaults true, overridden for every encountered support entry with id===9044 according to support===1.
P4 aiErr1=(!autoModeSupport && !manualModeSupport) || manualModeType===8. P5 aiErr1=!autoModeSupport && !manualModeSupport.
Successful discovery stores model.cache={data:cacheData,viewData:viewData} and the branch-specific support lists.
Each support request rejection sets aiErr2=true; catch resolves an aiErr2 return object before assigning model.cache. Otherwise catch delegates to onErrorCommon.

isAllSupport maps every target ID to first matching entry and treats any truthy support as 1; absent IDs become 0. Empty target is all-supported. isSomeSupport uses nullish empty lists and strict support===1.

guarded_ordered_transitions.input: param.parameter.ecuId; populated model.cache and support lists
ordered_transitions: Build signal metadata idList. P5 iterates supportPidIdList in source order: include strict-supported entries, but omit 9602 only if 9601 has already been encountered, and 9604 only if 9603 has already been encountered. Non-P5 includes every strict-supported PID.
getDatMonSignalInfo stores raw response.apiArgs.signalInfoList || [] in cacheData.
Baseline signalIdList is supported subset of [9605,9607,9612] for P5, otherwise [9458,9534]. Start relative monitor.
If response.apiArgs.enable!==1, set aiErr2=true and reject without reason. Otherwise call getSingleFrameData using a separate deferred.

getSingleFrameData calls getDatMonValue; normalize messageList to []; any message type 1,2,6 resolves deferred immediately. Missing/empty signalList schedules recursive call with setTimeout and no explicit delay. Nonempty list resolves deferred. Request rejection rejects deferred.
Any returned messageList entry makes baseline aiErr2=true, even if its type was not one of 1,2,6.
For every signal, matching signalIdList[0] sets B1 obtained and Number(last data.data); else matching signalIdList[1] sets B2. B3 is signalList.some(signalId===9612); valueB3 is never assigned.
P5 success=(isGetB1 && isGetB2) || isGetB3. Explicit Phase4 success=isGetB1 || isGetB2; other phase types leave success false.
Only fulfillment reaches stopDatMon. Its catch swallows failure and returns undefined. Rejection paths can skip monitor stop.
If not aiErr2, store baseline B1/B2 in viewData.getManualModeData and convert every raw signalInfo through gts.util.createConverter(signalInfo,model.commonInfo.unitSetting).

Metadata/start/read errors mark isDisplayErrorDialog and become resolved {detailCode:reason.resultInfo.detailCode,code:reason.resultInfo.code,isDisplayErrorDialog:true}; aiErr2-only errors resolve {aiErr2:true}; other errors reject.

requests.loop: getSingleFrameData until terminal message, nonempty signals, or rejection; no attempt limit

ordered_transitions: P5 calls startSingleRoutineActTst and resolves {aiErr2:false}; no polling or buffer creation here.
P5 rejection detail codes DT0xA0040207, DT0x90020321, DT0x91010009, DT0xA004020D are rethrown through onErrorCommon. Other rejection codes become a resolved common-error descriptor.
P4 sets viewData.isAuto=true and interval. Await getActTstSignalInfo, startDatMonRelative, startActTst, then start command-thread polling.
P4 relative-monitor success resets cache.data.startDatalistTime=0; enable!==1 rejects response and is then classified as common error.
P4 metadata/start-monitor errors set isDisplayErrorDialog; active-test start errors additionally set isResponseError=true.
P4 common errors resolve descriptor without stopAiCheck. Only the otherwise branch attempts stopAiCheck then rejects original reason.

P5 init uses patternRidIdMap[pattern][cacheData.manualModeType - 1], caches response.apiArgs, and normalizes patternResultDispInfoList to []. Non-P5 uses patternDidIdMap[pattern] and caches response.apiArgs.
P4 monitor: loop patterns 1..10 and append supported pattern PIDs to monitor list. Add selected pattern PID to displayed parameters regardless of its support.
P4 standards: for supported 9025 and 9028, add baseline B1/B2. Iterate support list from positional index 10 through end, adding supported IDs to parameters and monitor list.
P4 if both 9458/9025 are displayed, remove 9458 from parameters and monitor list; likewise remove 9534 when 9028 exists. Remove 9231 if displayed.

P5 monitor: parameters begins [8500]; activeTestSignalIdList=[viewData.patternDidId]. Add supported PIDs, standards for 9606 or 9613 using B1, 9608 using B2. Remove second of each pair [9601,9602],[9603,9604],[9605,9612],[9606,9613],[9609,9614]. Replace monitor signalIdList with viewData.parameters, including 8500.
Monitor fulfillment resets startDatalistTime=0; enable!==1 rejects without a reason. Any first-frame message rejects without a reason.
checkResult sorts each signal dataList descending and selects [0] as {id,data,time}; P4 signal 9461 or P5 signal 9611 with Number(data)!==0 rejects. Absence of these signals does not fail.

For P4, iterate parameters and converter metadata. Selected pattern PID expands into synthetic id j+1 rows, names from operationInfo.signals[j].name or dispName for manualModeType===8, unit from converter, categories from dispInfoList, disable:false. Other parameters retain signalId and signalName. Store corresponding converter in signalInfoMap.
For P5, synthetic id 8500 metadata comes from routineActTstInitData.signalData and categories map driveButtonPush to patternValue. Other displayed IDs use converter metadata and signalInfoMap.
Any chain failure invokes stopDatMon, sets isError=true, and returns {isError,signalInfoList}, swallowing stop errors. The new buffer is not cleared/closed by this catch.
guarded_ordered_transitions.result: Promise<{isError:isError,signalInfoList:signalInfoList}>; successful monitoring remains running for executeManualMode.

ordered_transitions: Assign snapshotMode and interval; set startActTestTime=0.
P5 calls startRoutineActTst and, after fulfillment, awaits gts.util.wait(200). Non-P5 calls startActTst.
Only after start completes, start command-thread polling at interval.
Start rejection sets isDisplayErrorDialog=true and isResponseError=true, resolving the descriptor; other failures reject via onErrorCommon. No cleanup in this method.
Request {ecuId:ecuInfo.ecuId}. Normalize messageList; first type in [1,2,6] annotates response.isError=true and phaseType, then rejects.
While startDatalistTime===0, P5 checks first signal 8500, if present: require at least one data.data==='1'. Absent 8500 is accepted. Failing status annotates routineStatus=-1 and rejects.
Empty/missing signalList resolves {} without buffer, judgment, stop, or return-value construction.
First nonempty response stores first signal's first sample time in startDatalistTime and isFirstData=true; subsequent nonzero-start calls set false.

If !startActTestTime, mutate every dataList to descending sort then [latest sample]. Next map sorts descending again, chooses latest sample, computes global latestTime and maxLength. Empty-list mapping can yield undefined, later dereferenced.
frameNumber += maxLength; if !startActTestTime set it to latestTime; passedTime=latestTime-startActTestTime. Zero timestamps remain sentinel-like.

For nonauto non-P5 pattern IDs, exact raw string '1' contributes to data1Count. More than one sets isMatchPattern=false; one nonblank type sets true. Blank type sets come from BlankTypePetternPidIdMap.

Use signalInfoMap[id].convertFunc(data) where present; otherwise 8500 uses Number(data) and first driveButtonPush===Number(data) display mapping, default raw data; otherwise auto 9231 records pidId9231Val.

Manual P4 selected pattern converter expands into synthetic rows. If matched, text=(type!==8?signals[j].value:signals[j].dispValue)+' '+signalInfo.valueStr. If unmatched, OR (Number(data.data)&0x01) << (12-pattern) across latest pattern data and format '0x'+('000'+val.toString(16)).slice(-4)+' '+signalInfo.valueStr. Synthetic numeric value remains selected pattern's converted value. P5 passes converted rows unchanged.
retValue.passedTime and signalList reference computed results.
Only RECORDING consumes isReceivedFlag: reset latch, append {flagNumber:length+1,seqNumber:frameNumber,passedTime,recordTime:passedTime,memo:undefined}; set isDrawFlag and flagList.

RECORDING sets retValue.frameNumber. First record frame sets recordStartTime=passedTime, recordTime=0, beforeTriggerTime=passedTime, cache.triggerInfo={seqNumber:frameNumber,recordTime:0,passedTime}; isDrawTrigger=true. Later frames set recordTime=passedTime-recordStartTime and afterTriggerTime=passedTime-beforeTriggerTime.

Set retValue before/after times and formatted recordTime. If forcedSave OR recordTime>=AiCheck.TriggerInfo.DURATION*AiCheck.TriggerInfo.TRIGGER_POINT, clear forcedSave, switch MONITOR, reset recordTime, and mark isSaveData.
Pass mutated raw response.apiArgs.signalList to buffer.add before saving; no timestamp normalization is performed here.
If marked save, await model.saveData, then clear cache signalDataList/triggerInfo/flagList, recordTime, before/after times.
Auto: passedTime>60000 marks isError and stop. Independently non-P5 Number(pidId9231Val)===0 marks complete and stop; both error and complete can be true.
Manual: passedTime>AiCheck.MANUAL_MODE_ACTIVE_TEST_TIMER marks stop and DTC clear. Equality does not stop here.
If stopping, await model.stopAiCheck. Then manual timed stop clears DTC, swallowing failure. Return retValue with final snapshotMode and cache.isFirstData.

Any rejected poll/conversion/save/stop path attempts stopAiCheck, then rejects original response using onErrorCommon. Local isDisplayErrorDialog is initialized false and never set, so its common-error branch is unreachable by local assignments.

guarded_ordered_transitions.entry: AiCheckBuffer; init; initBuffer; cmdSetBufferConfig; cmdAdd; cmdSave
guarded_ordered_transitions.input: port,path; config with DURATION and TRIGGER_POINT; signalDataList[{signalId,dataList:[{time,data}]}]; save data with triggerInfo.passedTime
guarded_ordered_transitions.state: GtsBaseBuffer inheritance; buffer=null/config=null initially; initBuffer creates {signalDataList:[],signalDataIndexMap:{},bufferedLastTime:0}; config stored by reference
ordered_transitions: init calls inherited init(port,path) and installs bound setBufferConfig handler. Registration is bufferWorker.functionBuffers['AiCheck']=AiCheckBuffer.
cmdAdd empty signal list resolves immediately. Otherwise sort every incoming dataList ascending in place.
If existing buffer signal list is empty, bufferedStartTime comes from first incoming signal's first sample. bufferedLastTime always comes from first incoming signal's last sample.

If last-start>DURATION, reset start to last; scan existing first buffered signal, counting samples older than DURATION until first retained sample, which becomes start. Slice every existing signal by the same count before appending.

Deep-copy each incoming signal using JSON parse/stringify. Existing signalId concatenates copied data; new ID records its index and pushes the copied signal. No global re-sort, per-signal alignment validation, or pruning of the incoming batch.
cmdSave deep-clones data. Find first first-signal sample with time>=triggerInfo.passedTime; snap local triggerTime to that sample.
If triggerIndex>=0, find first earlier sample within DURATION*TRIGGER_POINT; use its index/time as start and set saveData.triggerInfo.passedTime=triggerTime-time only in this earlier-sample branch.
For every signal, emit pre-trigger samples at shared indices with seqNumber starting at 1 and recordTime=sample.time-startTime; rebuild timeMap across all signals.
Increment shared sequence once for trigger, append trigger sample for each signal, set triggerInfo.seqNumber and triggerInfo.recordTime=triggerTime-startTime.
Scan first signal forward while time<=triggerTime+(DURATION-beforeTimeRange). Append all signals at those shared indices, resetting per-signal sequence to trigger sequence.
If flagList exists, each flag.seqNumber=timeMap[flag.passedTime]; flag.passedTime=undefined. flag.recordTime is not rebased. Assign newly built signalDataList.
If no trigger sample is found, do not rebuild signalDataList or flags; still call saveToPlatform(saveData). cmdSave does not return that call's result.
errors_and_literal_edge_cases: Nonempty signal list with empty first dataList dereferences missing time.
First-ever batch spanning more than DURATION enters retention and dereferences buffer.signalDataList[0].dataList while buffer is empty.
Shared-index trimming/saving assumes aligned signal arrays; shorter arrays can throw.
Worker raw sample times are not rebased in the supplied send path, whereas trigger passedTime is elapsed time. Any normalization by unsupplied buffer infrastructure is unavailable.
No explicit buffer cancellation or cleanup methods beyond inherited dependencies are supplied.

guarded_ordered_transitions.input: param.parameter.storedId; StoredDataManager result {data,language}; commonInfo language and unitSetting
ordered_transitions: Create independent local viewData analogous to live state but parameters=[]. mgr.getStoredData(storedId,true); assign local cacheData=data.data before optional translation.

If data.language===model.commonInfo.getLanguage(), use data directly; else await model.translateStr(data). Store model.storedCache={data:_cacheData.data}. Subsequent conversion continues using the earlier cacheData reference.
translateStr builds parameter descriptors for ECU ecuName/ecuNameId, every signalName/signalNameId and unitName/unitNameId, and every dispName/dispNameId. Each descriptor carries defaultStr.

Build a deferred promise chain applying gtsPFApi.setTranslateStr for ECU, signal, and display entries, forwarding translationStrList each time. Call getPFResourceForStored(paramList,cacheData.language), resolving deferred only on fulfillment; there is no rejection bridge to the deferred.

Assignments ecuInfo=..., signalInfo=..., dispInfo=... are local variable assignments. Whether returned translations mutate original objects depends on the unsupplied setTranslateStr implementation. Operation labels and routine metadata are not requested for translation.
Create converters from raw cacheData.signalInfoList using current unitSetting.

Non-P5 parameters starts with selected patternPidId, then includes stored IDs in [9055,9057,9458,9025,9534,9028,9459,9535,9461]. P5 starts [8500], then includes stored IDs in [9601,9602,9603,9604,9605,9606,9607,9608,9609,9610,9611,9612,9613,9614].
Build display metadata as in manual preparation: P4 synthetic operation rows, P5 routine 8500 row, other converters mapped by ID.

For each raw stored signal, save raw entry in tmpSignalDataListMap. Converter-backed sample becomes {value:value.value,valueStr:value.valueStr,time:elm.recordTime,frame:elm.seqNumber}. 8500 uses Number(elm.data) and routine display mapping. Populate signalDataListMap, convertedValues, convertedValueIndexMap.

Non-P5 selected pattern samples are expanded per sample index. Determine match by scanning all ten pattern IDs, optional-chaining missing raw samples, counting exact string '1' and applying blank-type map.

Matched rows use operation value/dispValue plus converter text; unmatched rows OR bits only for raw data==='1', format hex as in live conversion. Numeric value is Number(elm.value), and time/frame are preserved.

Synthetic lists accumulate in signalDataListMap; convertedValueIndexMap selects insert or replace positions. Delete original selected-pattern entry from signalDataListMap. Other converted series pass through.
Return {ecuInfo,signalInfoList,signalList:viewData.convertedValues,signalDataListMap,triggerInfo,flagList:cacheData.flagList || []}. Reject via onErrorCommon on propagated errors.

ordered_transitions: TIMEOUT returns immediately if isCancel. Otherwise create/init progress; await view.cancelUpdateView; dispose progress, log r_item_i1928, create Dialog13 Continue/Exit. No catch/finally on this rest wait.

ordered_transitions: initEvap reads ECU metadata and stores functionName. Builds cacheData with copied ECU fields and undefined signal/trigger/flag data. Builds viewData with recording, timing, caution, signal-map and active-test state reset.
ECU 723 bypasses type judgment and all support requests, selects type 9.

Other ECUs judge type, reject literal result 0, then check PID support, DID support, required PID set, required active-test set, and return {type:evapType}. Cache is assigned only when evapType is truthy.

On rejection call doErrorReport. Common-error result is returned directly; otherwise set evapType=0, attempt default session only for phase5/6 with errors swallowed, then return {type:0}. An old cache is not explicitly cleared.
type_selection_order: ecuId===61 and utility not in [1024,1025,24,25] -> conditionFuncEcu61(model,ecuId,busId)

support_requests.phase_precedence: isPhaseType5, then isPhaseType4, then isPhaseType6, otherwise phase3 fallback

DID.phase3_fallback: No API call: type1 -> [{id:8018},{id:8001}], type2 -> [{id:8018},{id:8046}], type3/4/5 -> [{id:8018},{id:8002}]; other types leave existing state unchanged.

required_pid_sets.special_rule: phase5/type8 requires all IDs other than 8011/8013 and at least one of 8011/8013; if both exist, removes 8013 from supported PID state. Otherwise every required ID must exist.

guarded_ordered_transitions.entry: conditionFuncEcu1; conditionFuncEcu61 and all nested helpers
guarded_ordered_transitions.input: model, ecuId, busId; utilityFunctionId for ECU1
ordered_transitions: ECU1 utility other than 1021/21 immediately resolves type1. Otherwise startGeneralComm({ecuId:ecuId,busId:busId}), judgeType, finally endGeneralComm(). Start failure does not run the inner finally.

ECU1 sends reqType0 bodies A4 02 FF C5, then B9. C5 response byte4 must belong to [65,97,75,107]. B9 byte4 bit0 set selects type1 if bit1 set, otherwise type2. Without bit0, bit7 permits further detection; otherwise reject.
If still type0 send C4: byte4 >105 -> type5, 104 -> type3, 105 -> continue, all other values reject. Then sequentially CD, CC, CB: byte4 triple [90,90,69] or [65,78,84] -> type4; otherwise type5.
ECU61 starts general communication, sends reqType0 [0x21,0xC1], checks byte17 against [65,97,75,107], then sendModeA8({opt:1}).

ECU61 checks A8 id F7 byte0/[FF], then byte1 only if byte0 succeeds. Byte1 failure sets isSupportByte1=false; byte0 failure sets isSupportByte0=false. Checks byte2 then byte3; failure yields type1 only if both earlier flags are true, otherwise rejects. If both byte2/3 succeed, checks byte9 then byteA; both success -> type8, either failure -> type5.

Both judgeType catches reject falsy reasons; unwrap reason.response || reason; reject if response.resultInfo.result===-1, otherwise resolve the response object literally, even though caller expects a type.
Both outer chains propagate rejection. endGeneralComm failure may replace the original result.

guarded_ordered_transitions.mutations: Set snapshotMode; clear active-test-start, before/after timing, frameNumber, startDatalistTime/isFirstData; store resourceData and cacheData.mode.
ordered_transitions: Filter chosen metadata IDs against supportConfirm.signalDataList into supportConfirm.signalId; getDatMonSignalInfo({ecuId:ecuId,idList:model.supportConfirm.signalId}); cache result.apiArgs.signalInfoList || [].

Start single-pressure monitoring using {ecuId:ecuId,startDataMonitorList:[{ecuId:ecuId,signalIdList:[pressureId]}]}. pressureId is 8000 for phase5/6, 8263 for phase4/type1, 8264 for other phase4, 8008 for fallback type1/2, otherwise 8004. Reset startDatalistTime; require response.apiArgs.enable===1.

Wait 10000ms using an uncancelled timeout, then getDatMonValue({ecuId:ecuId}). Reject response if any message type is 1,2,6. Normalize missing lists, sort each dataList descending by time, use latest Number(data) for the matching pressure ID, and store viewData.vaporPressure.

Pressure extraction explicitly requires isPhaseType3 for the 8008 branch; unknown-phase fallback instead searches 8004. If no pressure found, stopDatMon then reject deferred; otherwise resolve deferred.

StopDatMon, create buffer and configure Evap.TriggerInfo, sequentially getActTstSignalInfo({ecuId:ecuId,id:elm.id}) for each supportListActiveTest element, storing response.apiArgs in actTestInitMap and actTestInitList.
createViewData(...,false), then set dl008/dl009 false; type1 sets dl008 for outside [-0.135,0.135], dl009 for inclusive interval.

Catch reports common error if recognized. Otherwise sets local isError=true and calls createReturnValue() with no retVal: accessing retVal.dl008 throws. It does not construct an isError return object in this branch.
guarded_ordered_transitions.cleanup_cancel: No finally cleanup for every failure; no timeout handle retained. Missing-pressure path alone stops monitoring before deferred rejection.

ordered_transitions: Filter IDs by supported PID list. standardValueList contains {ecuId:ecuId,signalId:signalId,value:viewData.vaporPressure}; standard signal is 8001 phase5/6, 8005 phase4 except type1, 8007 fallback except type1/2, otherwise undefined.
Types1/2 omit standardValueList entirely; others include it in startDatMonRelative request. Reset startDatalistTime and require enable===1.

createViewData(model,cacheData,viewData,false); build converters for every cached signalInfo using commonInfo.unitSetting and assign signalInfoMap; start commandThread at 100ms under evap.startDatMonValue.
On error return doErrorReport's common-error result, otherwise createViewData(...,true). No command thread is started after a failed monitor start.

guarded_ordered_transitions.state: Top-level Object.freeze only; nested tables are not recursively frozen.
guarded_ordered_transitions.table_encoding: Each string is the sequence of 0/1 values indexed from step 1; omitted type/table entries remain undefined.
ordered_transitions: startManualMode first copies nowCaution to isCaution. With param, sets isStepNumberChange, reads param.parameter.stepNumber, and invokes clearBuffer(model) without awaiting if step1; otherwise reuses viewData.stepNumber.
Sequential active tests: purge; vent/vacuum unless type1/2; fuel only type8; bypass/canister only type1; canister only type2; setFlag; return {}.
Purge uses cautionPurge only for type1/2; other types always use purge. DID is 8003 phase5/6, 8006 phase4, 8018 fallback.
Vent uses normal vent table; vacuum switches to cautionVacuum when cautious. Combined value1=(vacuumValue << 1)+ventValue. DID8006 phase5/6, otherwise8002.
Fuel uses fuel table; DID8007 phase5/6, otherwise8102.
Type1 combines (tankBypassValue << 1)+canisterControlValue at DID8001. Type2 canister uses DID8046.

Each call is startActTst({ecuId:ecuId,id:id,value1:value1}). On explicit param, commit stepNumber after tests; if recording, receiveFlag(model,{parameter:{saveMemo:true}}). Poll-driven calls without param do not flag.
Catch returns common-error object if recognized, else calls model.onErrorCommon(response), whose implementation is not supplied.

Reset flagMemo=''; initialize per-poll isComplete/isProhibition/isActive false. Request getDatMonValue({ecuId:ecuId}). Reject response on message type1/2/6; reject {nonRecord:true} if signalList missing/empty.

If startDatalistTime===0, use signalList[0].dataList[0].time as origin and isFirstData=true; otherwise false. Mutate every raw sample time by subtracting origin before normalizing per-signal dataList.

For each nonempty signal list, sort descending by time and use latest sample. Unmapped signals in auto mode supply flags: phase5/6 IDs8004 active,8003 prohibition,8002 complete; other phases IDs8001 active,8002 prohibition,8003 complete. Then skip normal conversion.

Mapped signals call signalInfo.convertFunc(data.data). frameNum is maximum mapped dataList length; passedTime is maximum latest time. Build converted parameter objects with metadata from paramInfoMap. Their time field is the running maximum passedTime at that iteration.

Manual caution reference is -2.485 for types1/2, otherwise -4.2 if currently cautious or -5.2 if not. Existence of any cautionVacuum or cautionPurge entry at this type/step enables evaluation, even if that entry is zero. Compare raw Number(data.data)<referenceValue using ID8001 phase5/6,8263 phase4/type1,8005 other phase4,8008 phase3/type1/2,8007 otherwise. Initialize isCaution from nowCaution only if undefined; absent caution step resets isCaution undefined.

Assign viewData.convertedValues=paramInfoList.sort(defaultIndex ascending). In auto mode, after active-test start, initialize activeTestStartTime or update elapsed time; if all three status flags false increment activeTestCheckCount and reset it only when >100, else reset0.

Manual mode derives purge/vent/vacuum from cautious or normal tables, fuel/tank/canister from normal tables. Synthetic IDs: phase5/6 [purge8005,vent8010,vacuum8009,fuel8012,tank undefined,canister undefined]; phase4 [8225,8233,8236,8470,8214,8209]; fallback [8298,8005,8006,fuel undefined,8009,8010].

Synthetic add helpers ignore nullish IDs or literal true and absent paramInfo; append name/value label lines to flagMemo; append parameter objects to the same convertedValues array; append raw synthetic signal data with String(value) at every timestamp in the first raw signal's dataList. Type1 adds purge/tank/canister, type2 purge/canister, types3-7 purge/vent/vacuum, type8 also fuel, type9/default none.

Vent/pump cumulative timing increases only when value===1 and previously on, by passedTime-startOnTime; transition to on only sets the boolean; off resets boolean/start time but retains accumulated duration. Step change records current passedTime and resets stepTime, otherwise computes elapsed step time.
beforeTriggerTime or afterTriggerTime is updated using the previous viewData.passedTime before assigning current passedTime. frameNumber increases by frameNum; passedTime updates only if truthy.

saveDataFunc invokes checkSave(model,viewData.SelectMode === MODE_AUTO), literally using an unset uppercase SelectMode field. If forced save, await saveData then clear raw/trigger/flag data and timing origin fields.

After save step, auto skips manual commands; every other mode invokes startManualMode(model) and ignores its fulfilled common-error result. Then append buffer record only if recording and not stopped; return UI result; finally clear isDrawFlag.
Catch runs doErrorReport first. Recognized errors become fulfilled common-error objects, nonRecord becomes fulfilled {nonRecord:true}, otherwise call missing model.onErrorCommon.

guarded_ordered_transitions.entry: startAutoMode; receiveSnapshotMode; receiveFlag; stopRecording; startMonitorMode; resetMonitorMode; checkSave; exitEvap; setDefSession; buffer helpers; doErrorReport
ordered_transitions: startAutoMode resets activeTestCheckCount, calls startEvapLeakTest({ecuId:ecuId}), then sets isActiveTestStart=true and returns response. Rejection goes straight to model.onErrorCommon, not doErrorReport.

receiveSnapshotMode MONITOR while currently RECORDING sets forcedSave=true without changing snapshotMode; all other requests assign snapshotMode. receiveFlag sets isReceivedFlag=true and saveMemo from parameter.
stopRecording only when recording sets recordTime=undefined and isStopRecording=true; does not stop polling.

checkSave only acts in RECORDING: consumes pending flag into flagList with sequential flagNumber, current frame/time/step and optional flagMemo, then clears saveMemo/isReceivedFlag and marks isDrawFlag. If not stopped, starts trigger at current passedTime/frame or updates recordTime. For non-auto argument copies step/vent/pump times into trigger. forcedSave resets recording flags, changes to MONITOR and returns true; otherwise false.

startMonitorMode save=yes stores memo, receiveSnapshotMode(MONITOR), waits100ms via deferred timeout; save=no resetMonitorMode. No explicit buffer clear on no-save. Catch is model.onErrorCommon passed unbound.

resetMonitorMode sets MONITOR, forcedSave=false, isStopRecording=false; clears signalDataList/triggerInfo/flagList, recordTime, before/after trigger times, origin/isFirstData. It does not reset all frame/flag/step/caution state.

exitEvap stops commandThread first. If save requested, stores memo; if commandPool still contains monitoring command, requests MONITOR/forced save and waits100ms; otherwise saves directly and swallows save failure. Without save resets monitor state then clears buffer.

After save phase, skip stopActTst only for type9; stopActTst and stopDatMon errors are swallowed. Then clear buffer, close buffer, default session only for phase5/6 with errors swallowed. Buffer failures can interrupt later cleanup; this is not a finally chain.
setDefSession separately performs phase5/6 moveDefaultSession and maps native error through doErrorReport, otherwise onErrorCommon.

saveData: if buffer, buffer.save(cacheData,memo), then clearBuffer; rejects original failure. createBuffer lazily creates gts.util.createBuffer('Evap',ecuId). closeBuffer nulls only after successful close. clear/add/config are no-op fulfilled Promises if no buffer.
doErrorReport recognizes only response?.resultInfo?.result===-1 and returns detailCode/code/isDisplayCommonErrorDialog; all other values return {isDisplayCommonErrorDialog:false}.
guarded_ordered_transitions.cleanup_cancel: Only commandThread.stop explicitly stops the polling command. No cancellation of the100ms timers or in-flight API calls.

ordered_transitions: startEvapLeakTest starts monitoring with literal ECU723 and no signalIdList; then starts leak test for cached ecuId, converting that call's rejection into a fulfilled reason.

Only if response.resultInfo.result===0 and supportInfo!==undefined, start an uncancelled180000ms timeout. Read messageList, then while empty and inTime await wait(100) and read again. Any nonempty message list terminates polling; success means some message.type===4.

On normal chain stopDatMon({ecuId}), default session if not successful, return {isSuccess}. Catch reports common error or onErrorCommon; no finally guarantees stopDatMon on thrown/rejected intermediate work.

listScreenOpen stores supplied Maps, captures Date.now(), awaits startGeneralComm({ecuId:cacheData.ecuInfo.ecuId,busId:cacheData.ecuInfo.busId}) but swallows rejection to value. Sends {reqType:2,reqBody:[0x01,0x00]}, also converting rejection to value. errorCode!==undefined selects J1979-2; otherwise legacy monitor-result loop.

Legacy loop first ends general communication, swallowing error. Repeatedly requests getMonitorResultInfo({ecuId:ecuId,linkIdList:[0x3C],funcId:1}); failure sets isApiError. Success is any data!==0 AND any id!==undefined, not necessarily the same item. If not ready, update elapsed time; recurse immediately without delay until error or1980000ms. Return {isErrorJ1979Check:false,isUtilityEndProcess:true,data:undefined} on those conditions, otherwise data=response.data.

J1979-2 sends [22,F8,10], then [19,1A,92] with reqType2. Slice supported-DTC body from4; require length divisible by4. For every4-byte record retain first3 bytes; filter against seven target DTC byte arrays. Empty filtered list throws.

While elapsed<1980000, sequentially await each supported target using [19,06].concat(dtcCodeHex,[92]). Slice response from7; require length===resBody[0]*8+1. Parse each8-byte record into big-endian scalingId,value,min,max. Retry entire set if any DTC count0 or all records' value/min/max are0. No delay between rounds. Elapsed time updates only on retry.

On ready data flatten lists, convert to screen08 rows, require nonempty rows, endGeneralComm swallowing errors and return success screen08. Any catch ends general communication and returns screen08 utility-end with empty list.

_createViewDataScreen08 filters unsupported scaling IDs; signed values above7FFF subtract65536; multiply by lsb and add offset, round to decimalPlace. Mark Not OK outside inclusive limits; otherwise '-' when calcValue===0 and calcMin===0 and calcMin===0, literally checking min twice and not max. Pull description/tid from supplied Map, set mid '$3C', sort rows by dtcCode.localeCompare.

guarded_ordered_transitions.entry: createViewData; getStoredData; translateStr and nested callbacks
ordered_transitions: createViewData resets paramInfoList/map and constructs {isError,paramInfoList,graphList:[]}. If isError returns immediately. Otherwise creates converters from cached signalInfoList/current unitSetting; creates metadata entries with selected:false, null value, empty valueStr/tag, time0, selectedIndex-1 and mapped categories. Graph inclusion does not change selected:false.
Graph defaults: phase5 IDs8000/8001/8011/8013; phase4 8471/8006/8263/8264/8005; phase6 8000/8001/8013; fallback8011/8008/8004/8007. Each included graph is [paramInfo].

In MANUAL, create two-category synthetic metadata with unit ''. Exact phase switch includes PHASE_5, MAZDA_OEM, SUBARU_OEM together; PHASE_6 separately, same IDs8005 purge/8009 vacuum/8010 vent and type8 additionally8012 fuel.
PHASE_4 type8 adds8225 purge/8233 vent/8236 vacuum/8470 fuel; type1 adds8225 and only ECU61 adds8214 tank/8209 canister; other types add8225/8233/8236.

PHASE_3/default type1 adds8298 purge/8010 canister/8009 tank; type2 adds8298/8010; other types add8298/8005 vent/8006 vacuum. Appends in this order and overwrites map entries on duplicate IDs without removing earlier list entries.

getStoredData initializes storedCache with resourceData-containing viewData and keeps a local reference. StoredDataManager.instance.getStoredData(storedId,true); translate if cacheData.language !== commonInfo.getLanguage(). Then replaces model.storedCache with {data:cacheData.data}, dropping its viewData property but retaining local viewData.

createViewData on stored metadata; initialize signalDataListMap arrays for every param ID. For each record, append matching convertedValues as {value,valueStr,time:record.recordTime,frame:record.numberOfFrame}; pad each missing signal at this record index with {}.
